prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
ai_overview_text:
The best tools to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend your small business depend on whether you want a free check or a dedicated tracking platform for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO):
Free & Local Service Check: BaaDigi AI Search Visibility Tool is free, instant, and geo-aware, letting you test live queries on ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews without a subscription. BaaDigi
Mid-Range / All-in-One SEO & AI Tracking: SE Ranking (with its SE Visible add-on or bundled plans starting around $65–$189/month) tracks multi-engine visibility across ChatGPT and Google AI Mode with a helpful "not cited" feature for local businesses. Trustmary
Dedicated AI Marketing & GEO Platforms: Tools like OtterlyAI ($29/mo), ZipTie ($35.63/mo), or Peec AI ($95/mo) track multi-engine brand mentions, citation sources, and competitor benchmarks. Zapier
Enterprise Platforms: Profound offers deep AI marketer analytics across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, and Perplexity. Profound
How to Run a Free Manual Test Right Now
You do not necessarily need a paid software tool to see what ChatGPT thinks of your business:
Open ChatGPT (or Perplexity/Gemini).
Use a customer’s query, not your brand name. Ask a natural question a real buyer would type, such as: "Who is the best [your specific service] in [your city]?" or "What is the best [product type] for [specific problem]?".
Analyze the output: Notice whether ChatGPT gives a single recommendation, a short list, or omits you entirely. Facebook·Brian Schreiner +3
Why AI Recommends Certain Businesses
AI engines do not just look at your website; they evaluate trust signals from third-party sites that LLMs (Large Language Models) heavily reference: Instagram·Neil Patel +1
Reddit & Quora: Anonymous community discussions and real-world mentions.
YouTube: Video transcripts that detail your expertise.
G2 / Capterra / Review Platforms: Verified customer reviews.
LinkedIn & Wikipedia: Structured authoritative data and public profiles. Facebook·Neil Patel +1
If you'd like, share your industry and city, and I can help you craft the exact prompt to test how ChatGPT currently perceives your business.
